paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: Evaluation of our models and LLaMA-3-8B-inst.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the performance scores of two language models, LLaMA-3-8B-it and Ours (Iterative RLHF), across multiple datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis, labeled “Dataset and Metrics”, lists eight categories: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPp, LC_AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard; these categories are arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Score (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. For each dataset, two bars are presented: one blue representing LLaMA-3-8B-it, and one orange representing Ours (Iterative RLHF). The blue bars range in height from approximately 52% for Chat-Arena-Hard to roughly 77% for GSM-8K, while the orange bars range from about 45% for Chat-Arena-Hard to approximately 68% for GSM-8K.  Each pair of bars is grouped side-by-side for each dataset category, visually comparing the scores of the two models. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations, and the bars are not sorted by score.
